question: v2 Question A: does independent published evidence justify expanding the admissible N2 chemistry energy domain beyond 45 eV mean energy (T_e 30 eV)?
statement: Do not widen the active N2 chemistry validity domain beyond 45 eV mean energy. The only defensible partial extension (dissociation to 60 eV) does not materially unblock validation/admission: with rotational excitation capped at 45 eV, a minimal v2 on the same P5-N2 evidence cannot make any present screening candidate promotable.
preserved_candidate_evidence: lane-01 finding: dissociation has process-specific evidence supporting a possible 60 eV limit under its stated 1 % convention. Recorded as candidate evidence for a FUTURE model revision, not as the active domain; it rests materially on two reconstructed points not fully independent of the baseline source set.
binding_rules: A change of a validity limit alone (tables byte-identical) is a CONTROLLED MODEL-DOMAIN CHANGE: it alters admissible solver states, scoreability, OUT_OF_DOMAIN classification and downstream conclusions; if ever adopted it must be versioned, logged in docs/HISTORY.md, separately pre-registered and rerun. Never metadata housekeeping.

A v2 scored on the same P5-N2 measurements after the v1 results are known is NOT new evidence for promoting a screening transport closure. Promotion requires genuinely new predictive evidence not used in selecting the closure (held-out/previously unused experimental conditions, new independently published measurements, or a new common-condition experiment).

Question B (fo_v2_excitation_question_b) is BLOCKED_BY_QUESTION_A_DISPOSITION: T_V2_QUESTION_B requires this disposition to leave the domain path open; with A-NO it can never become READY. Johnson-low continues only through the pre-registered O4/escalation path (sensitivity != validation).
O4 stages 3-5, all escalations, the O4 disposition matrix and Bundle 1 continue unchanged.

sub_decisions.D-X12_reconstructed_Winters_points_suffi: NO for an active domain change; retained as supporting evidence
sub_decisions.D-X2_evaluated_vs_measured_only: no change now; measured-only default retained if reopened
sub_decisions.D-X3_relax_or_change_extension_threshold: NO (no threshold change after seeing results)
sub_decisions.D-X6_to_D-X10: DEFERRED until evidence suffices to reopen the model-domain question

D-X5_bounded_priorities: 1. Rotational excitation cross sections above 10 eV (structural blocker: with the rotational cap at most 37 of 714 OOD runs are recoverable)
2. Electronic excitation above 100 eV (above 200 eV for a1Pi_g), resolving the Johnson / Majeed & Strickland 1997 / Kawaguchi inconsistencies
3. Non-resonant vibrational excitation / completeness (material missing contribution, not only a range issue)
4. Additional independent dissociation evidence above ~296-330 eV, only after 1-3 improve
D-X5_rules: published/open sources only; no contact with laboratories or authors; no LXCat; no paywall/bot-challenge bypass; bounded to the four priorities (not an open-ended literature lane)
reopening_condition: Reopen Question A only when genuinely new published evidence materially closes the rotational / electronic / vibrational domain gaps.
